# Page packets — Prosperity

64 pages, 6.625 x 10.25 inches. Made by the writers' room; every packet below is complete on its own.

## How to use these packets

1. **Start with the sheets** below: the character sheet, then the location sheet. Paste each,
   keep the results, and attach them as reference images with every page that names them
   (each page packet says which). Approve one page as your style page and attach that too.
   For a long book, train a LoRA on the approved sheets and pages; references alone drift.
2. **One page at a time.** Paste everything under a page's heading, nothing else. Keep the
   same model and settings for the whole book so the style and the characters stay put.
3. **No text on the pages.** The words are added afterwards, in the room, as a layer over
   your art - so a beautiful model that cannot spell is fine. If the model draws any letters,
   regenerate; do not keep a page with text on it.
4. **Check the page** against its checklist before you keep it. One thing wrong: regenerate
   with the same packet, and only then adjust wording.
5. **Upload each kept page** in the room (Production, Lettering tab) and run the lettering:
   the room draws every balloon and caption where the layout put them, and you download the
   finished, lettered page.

## Rules for every page

- Never render text of any kind: no balloons, captions, sound effects, page numbers,
  titles, chapter names, signatures, watermarks, nameplates or labels.
- Keep the areas each panel lists as clear: uncluttered art (sky, wall, shadow) where a
  balloon will sit, never a face or the thing the panel is about.
- Draw every character exactly as described, every time. The description wins over the
  previous page's picture.
- Panel count, panel shape and reading order are fixed by the map. Do not add, merge or
  reshape panels.

## Character sheet — draw this first

_Copy everything under this heading and paste it into the image model._

Draw one character reference sheet: every character below standing full length in a row, front view, neutral pose, even daylight, plain light background, in the book's style. Same scale for everyone so heights compare. No text, names, labels or captions anywhere on the sheet.

**Style:**

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.

- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. ## Page 5 of 47 — Prosperity
_Copy everything under this heading and paste it into the image model._

Draw one finished comic book page: a portrait page, 6.625 x 10.25 inches (about 2:3), the right-hand page of the book, with 4 panels. Fully inked and colored, clean panel borders with even white gutters. NO TEXT anywhere on the page.

**Style (the same on every page):**

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.

- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.

- **ADA** — Ada Veyra is twenty years old, compact, strong and approximately average height, with a steady, rooted posture shaped by life and work in Keel. - **ADRIAN** — Adrian Phantum is a European-descended man in his late thirties in the surviving recordings and photographs, lean, long-limbed and slightly stooped from years over workbenches. ## Page 18 of 47 — Prosperity
_Copy everything under this heading and paste it into the image model._

Draw one finished comic book page: a portrait page, 6.625 x 10.25 inches (about 2:3), the left-hand page of the book, with 4 panels. Fully inked and colored, clean panel borders with even white gutters. NO TEXT anywhere on the page.

**Style (the same on every page):**

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.

**Characters — draw them exactly as described:**

His right eye ring cli
- **ALEX** — Alex Phantum is seventeen years old, lean, wiry and approximately average height, with a compact mechanic's build shaped by lifting tools and working around machinery. He has mixed Indigenous Andean and European-descended features: a strong brow, wide-set dark brown eyes, a straight nose, a firm mouth and a jaw that recalls Adrian without making Alex a younger copy of him; his warm medium-brown skin is usually marked by dust, grease and small work scratches. ## Page 23 of 47 — Prosperity

Draw one finished comic book page: a portrait page, 6.625 x 10.25 inches (about 2:3), the right-hand page of the book, with 4 panels. Fully inked and colored, clean panel borders with even white gutters. NO TEXT anywhere on the page.

**Style (the same on every page):**

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.

After the Site 6 accident, his lower leg is bruised and wrapped. His silhouette is sturdy and slightly stooped from years underground. His signature detail
- **ALEX** — Alex Phantum is seventeen years old, lean, wiry and approximately average height, with a compact mechanic's build shaped by lifting tools and working around machinery. He has mixed Indigenous Andean and European-descended features: a strong brow, wide-set dark brown eyes, a straight nose, a firm mouth and a jaw that recalls Adrian without making Alex a younger copy of him; his warm medium-brown skin is usually marked by dust, grease and small work scratches. - **ADA** — Ada Veyra is twenty years old, compact, strong and approximately average height, with a steady, rooted posture shaped by life and work in Keel. Her long copper hair is wind-tangled and usually gathered loosely at the nape, with escaped strands lifting in the basin wind. She

**Style (the same on every page):**

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.

- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

**Style (the same on every page):**

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.

```text
## Page 40 (left) — Lock offers Alex relief in exchange for control.

**Panel 1.** Director Cassian Lock approaches, examining the registry before Alex.

LOCK: Assign the estate to House administration. Your debt clears. Halyard access becomes permanent.

**Panel 2.** Behind him, three House emblems divide the registry screen: Caldera, Vector and Orbital.

**Panel 3.**

LOCK: Refuse, and immediate commercial rights freeze pending review.

ALEX: You’re asking me to sell work I didn’t make.

LOCK: I’m offering scale, employment and a clean account.

**Panel 4.** Alex closes the registry. Lock taps the display. The estate locks.

ALEX: No.

LOCK: Then find the people who made it.

PAGE CHECK: Lock’s offer is genuine; refusal creates the collaborator search.

---
```

Draw one finished comic book page: a portrait page, 6.625 x 10.25 inches (about 2:3), the right-hand page of the book, with 4 panels. Fully inked and colored, clean panel borders with even white gutters. NO TEXT anywhere on the page.

**Style (the same on every page):**

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.

- **ALEX** — Alex Phantum is seventeen years old, lean, wiry and approximately average height, with a compact mechanic's build shaped by lifting tools and working around machinery. - **SURI** — Suri Anik is a young adult researcher with a slim, slightly hunched build, medium-brown skin, a round thoughtful face, dark brown eyes and thick black hair cut to the shoulders and usually tucked behind one ear. She wears a worn pale research coat over a dark green shirt, practical trousers, soft laboratory shoes and a narrow wrist sensor stained with biofilter medium. Draw one finished comic book page: a portrait page, 6.625 x 10.25 inches (about 2:3), the right-hand page of the book, with 4 panels. Fully inked and colored, clean panel borders with even white gutters. NO TEXT anywhere on the page.

**Style (the same on every page):**

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.

- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

## Page 60 of 47 — Prosperity
_Copy everything under this heading and paste it into the image model._

Draw one finished comic book page: a portrait page, 6.625 x 10.25 inches (about 2:3), the left-hand page of the book, with 4 panels. Fully inked and colored, clean panel borders with even white gutters. NO TEXT anywhere on the page.

**Style (the same on every page):**

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.

He wears a patched charcoal mining jacket, dust-stained trousers, heavy boots and a worn miner's wrist guard bearing a carved balanced water-drop mark. After the Site 6 accident, his lower leg is bruised and wrapped. His silhouette is sturdy and slightly stooped from years underground. His signature detail
- **ADA** — Ada Veyra is twenty years old, compact, strong and approximately average height, with a steady, rooted posture shaped by life and work in Keel. She has mixed Indigenous Andean and European/criolla ancestry, a broad expressive face, warm olive-brown skin, a straight nose, high cheekbones, freckles across her cheeks and nose, and light teal-blue eyes. Her long copper hair is wind-tangled and usually gathered loosely at the nape, with escaped strands lifting in the basin wind. She

**Style (the same on every page):**

Inked graphic-novel realism with heavy contour, textured hatching, painterly digital color, expressive acting and tactile architectural detail. The future is mostly recognizable infrastructure aged, repaired and institutionalized, with emerging technology ordinary and genuinely speculative mechanisms rare.

Prosperity is one mixed Andean high-desert basin, not three ethnic enclaves. Indigenous Andean, mestizo, European-descended, Afro-descendant, diasporic, mixed and international populations live across all three cities. Class, access, occupation, health, clothing, grooming, speech, environment and institutional power create the principal visual distinctions.

- **Keel:** compressed, wind-scoured and dignified; rust, charcoal, oxidized orange, dust, patched machinery, narrow channels, old pipes and crowded housing.
- **Halyard:** productive and commercially polished; bronze, gold and engineered green; laboratories, fabrication towers, maker districts, House facilities and elevated rail.
- **Oasis:** spacious, quiet and controlled; pearl-white architecture, reservoirs, geometric gardens, formal transit and clean institutional interiors.

Alpha has no face, body or human-like consciousness. Show it through white-and-amber control nodes, cold displays, gates, records, drones, restrictions and administrative language.

Alex remains visibly shaped by Keel as he moves upward. Bi11bot is rugged, foldable, scarfed and expressive through two warm optical eyes: patient, dry, useful and fallible, never menacing or a substitute for human judgment. TJ appears only in the 2070 prologue, if used there; he does not appear in the 2043 story.
